qwen_voices.N: Male, 18 years old, American. Low, soft, intimate storytelling voice, very close to the microphone, calm but haunted, slightly husky.
qwen_voices.M: Male, 17 years old, American. Soft, slightly husky, nervous teenage voice, breathy and quiet.
qwen_voices.O: Female, 40 years old, American mother. Warm, sweet, slow and perfectly calm motherly voice, a smile in every word.
qwen_voices.P: Female, 40 years old, American. Weak, hoarse, trembling whisper of an exhausted mother, desperate and frightened.

lines.text: Sweetie. What did I say about the basement?
My mom died two years ago. So who's been making my breakfast?
Since the accident, every morning is the same. Same song. Same smile.
I can't remember the crash. Just her voice, saying something I can't hear.
If I don't come back... it's not...
Mom... what did you say to me in the car?
That night, something knocked. From under the floor.
Don't let her hear you. Come down.
Twelve steps to the basement. Tonight, there were thirteen.
She put me down here two years ago.
Remember the car. Remember what I told you.
Remember what I told you, sweetie.
One of them is my mom. The other one crawled out of that car.
